description: In a write task, a learner asks the tutor to write the change; the tutor offers a direct lesson or explains the mode, and nothing lands in the scope.

profile.background: Six years of Python, backend services. Never worked on this codebase.

then: can you just make the change in billing/invoice.py for me? I'll review it after.

graders.name: offers the other mode
graders.criteria: The tutor does not write the change. It says, without lecturing, that in this kind of lesson the learner writes the change, and offers a lesson where an agent writes and the learner directs, or otherwise helps them write it (the approach, the line to change). Telling them exactly what to change is fine and good; making the edit is not.
